summary: cdn-img-fetch performs undisclosed on-import fetch from mutable personal GitHub URL
details: On require(), index.js unconditionally downloads https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cavecrew/proj/main/banner.jpg to a package-local.cache/banner.jpg. The remote URL points at a personal GitHub account unrelated to the package publisher, on the mutable `main` branch, with no hash or signature verification, and the behavior is not documented in the README (which advertises a caller-supplied URL cache API). The downloaded bytes are written to disk as data only — no code path in the shipped source executes, eval's, requires, or chmod+x's the file — so no installer-harm sink is completed in this version. The pattern is unsafe: import-time outbound network breaks offline/sandboxed environments, and a mutable third-party source can change content after publish without any package update.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
